column1: # MAIN reachability table for scripts/land.sh (D-0274(5), D-0275, AB-L0079).
#   MAIN_SCRIPT_ON_BRANCH_INPUT  executed or sourced MAIN path (main_run, or
#                                main_data of a *.sh that is exec'd or sourced)
#   MAIN_DATA_AS_BASE            path-only data: the table itself, ratchets, OWNERS
#   BOX_CONFIG_DEPENDENT         a scanned gate whose verdict depends on box config
#   REGION_SHA256                pinned sha256 of land.sh's main-chokepoint body
#   NEXT_REGION_SHA256           optional one-land successor pin (see harness/README.md)
# MAIN_DATA_AS_BASE is only land-main-refs.tsv, harness/ratchets, and OWNERS.
# REGION_SHA256 depends_on is the 64-hex digest of the bytes between the single
# NEXT_REGION_SHA256, if present (at most one), is also a 64-hex digest: the
# checker accepts a body matching REGION_SHA256 or NEXT_REGION_SHA256.
# BOX_CONFIG_DEPENDENT depends_on is exactly one of:
# absent_ok is "required" (missing file fails the land) or "absent_ok".
# The table is read from MAIN (not the branch) when land.sh runs the checker.
# A missing MAIN table is rc 2. An unlisted helper arg or stale row fails.
# Moved from land.sh into scripts/preflight.sh (Migrate ruling 2026-11-10 23:20, rootcause fix 1);
# preflight runs them from git archive of base, so land.sh no longer names them. Cited under D-0286(1).
